summary: This standards-track RFC defines a portion of the Management Information Base (MIB) for network management, with objects for managing a softwire mesh.

eli5.summary: A list of settings and counters that lets management software watch and configure softwire mesh tunnels.

questions: what is the softwire mesh mib
subtitle: The SNMP MIB that lets operators monitor softwire mesh tunnels on border routers.

tldr.problem: Softwire mesh routers carry IPv4 over an IPv6 backbone or the reverse, and operators need a standard way to see which tunnel types, encapsulation mappings and BGP neighbors a router has.
tldr.mechanism: It defines the SOFTWIRE-MESH-MIB module with three read-only tables: supported tunnel types, an encapsulation table mapping E-IP prefixes to I-IP next hops, and BGP neighbors with their tunnel type.
tldr.outcome: Operators can read softwire mesh state through SNMP. Every object is read-only, and the RFC recommends SNMPv3 security for reading it.

today: RFC 7856 is a Proposed Standard published in May 2016. The metadata lists no RFC that obsoletes or updates it.

sections.title: What the MIB Is For
sections.content:
The softwire mesh framework (RFC 5565) is a tunneling mechanism that connects islands of IPv4 networks across a single IPv6 backbone, and vice versa. Extended Multiprotocol BGP is used to set up the tunnels and advertise prefixes among Address Family Border Routers (AFBRs).

RFC 7856 defines a portion of the Management Information Base (MIB) for managing a softwire mesh. MIB objects are normally read through the Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) and are written in the Structure of Management Information, here SMIv2 (RFC 2578, RFC 2579, RFC 2580). The framework overview is in RFC 3410.
sections.eli5: A softwire mesh is a set of secret tunnels between routers. This RFC gives network managers a standard way to look at those tunnels.

sections.title: The Three Tables
sections.content:
The module hangs under swmMIB, assigned as { mib-2 239 }. It has three tables of objects plus a conformance subtree.

  • swmSupportedTunnelTable lists which tunnel types the AFBR can use. The framework does not mandate a tunneling technology. The types include L2TPv3 over IP, GRE, Transmit tunnel endpoint, IPsec in Tunnel-mode, IP in IP with IPsec Transport Mode, MPLS-in-IP with IPsec Transport Mode, and IP in IP. Detailed encapsulation data such as the L2TPv3 Session ID or GRE Key is not managed here.
  • swmEncapsTable holds the NLRI-NH information. It maps an External-IP (E-IP) destination prefix to the Internal-IP (I-IP) address of the next hop, which decides the outer destination address when a packet is encapsulated. The number of entries shows how many softwire mesh tunnels the AFBR maintains.
  • swmBGPNeighborTable lists the AFBR's softwire mesh BGP peers and the kind of tunnel used to reach each.

The encapsulation table is indexed by ifIndex, the E-IP address type, the E-IP address and the prefix length. Only the I-IP address type and address, and the tunnel type columns, are readable.
sections.eli5: One list says which kinds of tunnels the router knows. Another says 'for packets going to this place, send them to that router'. The third lists the router's tunnel friends.

sections.title: Fit with the Interfaces and IP Tunnel MIBs
sections.content:
A softwire mesh interface is a tunnel, so it gets an entry in the Interfaces MIB (RFC 2863) and in the IP Tunnel MIB (RFC 4087), linked by ifIndex. The module requires an implementation of the IP Tunnel MIB.

  • ifOperStatus is up if the softwire mesh capability was negotiated during the BGP OPEN phase, and down otherwise.
  • In an IPv4-over-IPv6 tunnel, ifInUcastPkts counts IPv6 packets sent to the virtual interface for decapsulation, and ifOutUcastPkts counts IPv6 packets produced by encapsulation, counted after fragmentation. The IPv6-over-IPv4 case is the mirror image.
  • tunnelIfEncapsMethod MUST be set to softwireMesh(16).
  • tunnelIfRemoteInetAddress MUST be 0.0.0.0 for IPv4 or :: for IPv6, because the tunnel is point-to-multipoint.

The tunnel direction follows from the address types: E-IP IPv6 with I-IP IPv4 means IPv6-over-IPv4, and E-IP IPv4 with I-IP IPv6 means IPv4-over-IPv6.
sections.eli5: The tunnel counts as a normal network connection too, so it shows up in the usual lists, and the new lists add the extra details.

sections.title: Conformance
sections.content:
The compliance statement swmCompliance makes three groups mandatory: swmSupportedTunnelGroup (the tunnel type), swmEncapsGroup (the I-IP address type and address) and swmBGPNeighborGroup (the neighbor tunnel type).

The index objects cannot carry OBJECT clauses, so the statement lists their requirements in comments: an implementation must support global IPv4 and/or IPv6 addresses, depending on its support for each.
sections.eli5: A checklist says which lists a router must provide to claim it supports this MIB.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.content:
The module defines no objects with read-write or read-create access, so, if implemented correctly, an intruder cannot change or create its objects with SNMP SET operations.

The readable objects can still be sensitive: swmSupportedTunnelType, swmEncapsIIPDstType, swmEncapsIIPDst and swmBGPNeighborTunnelType can expose the tunnel types in use and potentially the internal topology. Access should be controlled, and values possibly encrypted in transit.

Implementations SHOULD provide the SNMPv3 security features. Deploying SNMP versions before SNMPv3 is NOT RECOMMENDED. Because the module reuses the IP Tunnel MIB, that MIB's security considerations also apply.
sections.eli5: You can only look, not change. But what you see could show how the network is wired, so only trusted people should be allowed to look.

sections.title: IANA Assignments
sections.content: IANA allocated the object identifier { mib-2 239 } for swmMIB in the SMI Numbers registry. It also recorded softwireMesh(16) in the IANAtunnelType textual convention of the IANAifType-MIB, which is the value the IP Tunnel MIB's tunnelIfEncapsMethod uses for these tunnels.
sections.eli5: The official number list now has a slot for this MIB and a code for this kind of tunnel.
